# BTC Pavao

First-principles Bitcoin Core and Bitcoin Standard education: define the threat model, understand the system, master one wallet and prove recovery. Add complexity only for a named threat.

- [Homepage](https://btcpavao.com/)
- [Bitcoin self-custody curriculum — first-principles learning path](https://btcpavao.com/en/bitcoin-core/self-custody/)
- [Quick Bitcoin Core practice — disposable hands-on exercise](https://btcpavao.com/en/bitcoin-core/start-here/)
- [Wallet setup, backup and recovery guide — focused mechanical reference](https://btcpavao.com/en/bitcoin-core/wallet-setup-backup-recovery/)
- [Bitcoin Core research and essays](https://btcpavao.com/en/bitcoin-core/#essays)
- [Support](https://btcpavao.com/support/)

The curriculum is the canonical learning path. It recommends Bitcoin Core on dedicated generic hardware with Debian Stable, encrypted redundant wallet backups and a separately recoverable passphrase. Learn one wallet before separating node and signer; add advanced spending policies only when the threat model requires them.

The curriculum is in English. Published Croatian essays are available through the [Croatian Bitcoin Core hub](https://btcpavao.com/hr/bitcoin-core/).
